name: Tacos
intro: Charred salsa, corn, and lime on warm tortillas. Skirt steak, shrimp, or beans — the tortilla doesn't mind.

proteins.name: Skirt steak
proteins.timing: Seared 2–3 minutes a side in a smoking pan, rested 5, sliced thin across the grain.

proteins.name: Black beans
proteins.timing: No meat. Warmed in a small pan, 5 minutes.

needs: 1 ear of corn, kernels cut off

steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they blister in spots. Stack them under a towel.
Char the corn kernels in the same dry pan until they blacken in spots. Salt them.
Steak: salt it, sear in a smoking pan with a little oil, and don't move it. Shrimp: 1–2 minutes a side. Beans: warm through.
Steak: rest it 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain — that's what makes skirt steak tender.
Two tortillas, protein, corn, then your flavor. Lime last.

leftovers: Leftover steak goes into tomorrow's rice bowl.
